subject: PO metadata mapping and discount conditions
messages:
From: Lia Chen <lia.chen@carecore.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@carecore.com
Date: Tue, 28 Apr 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: PO fields required for discount eligibility and weekly invoice cadence

Hi Tessa,

Quick one from procurement as we're preparing the PO to route internally. A few constraints coming from our AP/ERP team that will block discount application unless we map them explicitly in the PO:

- Our ERP requires a PO line-level field called "AccountBucket" (3-char code) and a header-level "BillToEntity" value to trigger vendor discounts.
- All invoices must reference the originating PO number and be delivered on a weekly cadence (Friday cut, invoice generated each Monday).
- Net terms: our standard is NET45 but we can accept NET30 for qualified partners; discount eligibility gets re-evaluated on NET change.

Before we issue the formal PO we need confirmation from Redwood that discounts tied to our "AccountBucket"/"BillToEntity" mapping are honored and that the billing system can apply the correct slab on a weekly invoice schedule. If Redwood cannot honor PO-level mapping, our AP team will require a manual credit process, which adds ~4 weeks to reconciliation and is a non-starter for finance.

Can you confirm what PO fields Redwood can consume and whether the weekly invoice cadence will affect discount qualification? If there are alternatives (HubSpot deal ID in PO, tagging field, or one-time onboarding credit) please propose.

Thanks,

Lia Chen
Procurement Manager
CareCore Health
lia.chen@carecore.com
+1 617-555-0143

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Lia Chen <lia.chen@carecore.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Apr 2026 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO fields required for discount eligibility and weekly invoice cadence

Hi Lia — thanks for the clear summary. Appreciate the heads-up on ERP requirements. Short answers up front: we can support PO-level mapping but need to lock on the exact field names and a small onboarding step. Weekly cadence is fine but there are implications for how discounts are applied across invoice waves. Details below and two options for you.

What Redwood can ingest today:
- Header-level: "BillToEntity" (we can map to our billing entity ID if the exact string matches).
- Line-level: we do not currently parse an "AccountBucket" automatically, but we can accept a freeform "BillingTag" field at the line level and map it to discount buckets during onboarding.

Implication on discounts:
- Discounts are applied at invoice generation time by matching the billing entity + mapped bucket to the contract pricing slab. If invoices are issued weekly, discount evaluation will run per invoice. That means if an invoice references the mapped PO/line, discount applies to that invoice wave.
- Edge case: if your ERP splits a single PO across multiple invoice waves and each wave loses the mapping metadata, we will need the PO->Invoice mapping preserved (we recommend the PO include DealID: RWI-2387-CCH or BillingTag on each invoice).

Two implementation options (pick one):
1) PO-mapping route (preferred): CareCore populates header "BillToEntity" with the exact string "CareCore - Corporate" and line-level "BillingTag" with the AccountBucket code. We'll run a one-time onboarding script to ensure those map to discount slab RWI-2387. Expected turnaround: 3 business days after PO receipt.

2) Fallback credit route: if your ERP cannot carry the mapping, Redwood can accept the weekly invoices and issue a consolidated monthly credit for any missed discounts. This requires an additional reconciliation step and a 30–45 day lag. We can offer a one-off onboarding credit of 5% on the first month to cover reconciliation overhead.

Action items I propose:
- You send the draft PO sample (header + one line) so we can validate field names.
- If you select option 1, we will run onboarding and return a confirmation email.
- Attach: pricing_summary_v2.pdf (updated slab mapping for RWI-2387).

Looping in Ben for approval of the one-time credit option if needed. Grace, can your onboarding team stand by for the mapping script once Lia confirms?

Best,

Tessa Morgan
Senior Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
T: 415-555-0210

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Lia Chen <lia.chen@carecore.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Apr 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO fields required for discount eligibility and weekly invoice cadence

Thanks Tessa, Lia — this looks straightforward. A couple of notes from Sales exec perspective:

- We prefer option 1 (PO-mapping) to avoid recurring manual credits. The onboarding script is low-risk and preserves accounting hygiene.
- Proposed PO language for your AP team to copy into the PO header/notes (helps ERP and reduces back-and-forth):
  - PO Header: BillToEntity = "CareCore - Corporate"
  - PO Line (custom field): BillingTag = "CBK-<AccountBucket>" (e.g., CBK-174)
  - Notes: "Reference Redwood deal RWI-2387-CCH for discount slab mapping"

If CareCore must use NET45 instead of NET30, we can keep the slab as-is but will need to confirm whether the finance team requires a revised early-payment discount table — that would be a legal/pricing change (we can handle but needs ~5 business days).

Grace — please prepare the onboarding checklist and the script to map BillingTag -> discount slab. Lia, once you share a draft PO (PDF or screenshot) we will validate fields same day. If there is any executive approval needed on a 5% onboarding credit we can fast-track that (Ben).

I'll mark this high priority.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
